test_title: PYST 8:SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On:17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, Il and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some spoons are black.

All black are crows.

No crow is a plate.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some black are spoons.

Il. All crows are black.

III. No plate is a crow.

options.text: Only conclusions I and Ill follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5e7e9a98db7a0340882d5385a8b221e4604a65ee642104a2cd23186f59df2d6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some black are spoons → Follow (As, some spoons are black. So, as some part of spoons is common with black therefore it is definitely true.)

II. All crows are black → Does not Follow (As, All black are crows. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. No plate is a crow → Follow (As, no crow is a plate. So, direct cross or negative relation is given between plate and crow therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusions I and Ill follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I and Ill follow**".
